title: kith-core: JMAP Request/Response/Invocation types
description:
What: Define JMAP Request, Response, and Invocation types in src/jmap.rs.

Module file: crates/kith-core/src/jmap.rs — create this file, then add 'pub mod jmap;' to src/lib.rs.

Also define: pub type UTCDate = String; and pub type Id = String; in this file.

Algorithm:
1. Define type aliases:
   pub type UTCDate = String;  (RFC 3339 timestamp string, e.g. "2026-04-18T20:14:00Z")
   pub type Id = String;  (opaque non-empty string)
2. Define Invocation as a tuple struct that serializes as a 3-element JSON array:
   [method_name: String, arguments: serde_json::Value, call_id: String]
   Use #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")] is not applicable to tuple structs.
   Simplest: pub type Invocation = (String, serde_json::Value, String);
3. Define JmapRequest struct:
   using: Vec<String>  (capability URIs, e.g. ["urn:ietf:params:jmap:core", "urn:kith:chat:1"])
   method_calls: Vec<Invocation>  → #[serde(rename="methodCalls")]
   Derives: Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize.
4. Define JmapResponse struct:
   method_responses: Vec<Invocation>  → #[serde(rename="methodResponses")]
   session_state: String  → #[serde(rename="sessionState")]
   Derives: Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize.
5. Define MethodError struct (used in error invocations):
   error_type: String  → #[serde(rename="type")]
   description: Option<String>  → #[serde(skip_serializing_if="Option::is_none")]
   Derives: Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize.
6. Add 'pub mod jmap;' to src/lib.rs.
7. Run: cargo check -p kith-core

Defensive programming rules:
- Invocation tuple is untyped (serde_json::Value for args) — type safety is handled at dispatch time in kith-jmap
- No validation in these types — they are wire envelopes

Tests (independent oracle: RFC 8620 §3.3 and §3.4 example JSON):
- JmapRequest round-trip: build a request with two invocations, serialize, assert JSON matches RFC example format
- JmapResponse round-trip: build response, serialize, deserialize, assert fields match
- MethodError: serialize with and without description, assert JSON field presence
